plp.product_card: a[data-testid='product-tile'], a[data-testid='product-card'], li.grid-tile a.thumb-link, a.product-card__link, .product-grid a[href*='/en-jp/'][href$='.html']

rationale: We landed on the Moncler JP homepage, which is not a PLP. The site likely shows a cookie consent (OneTrust) and requires navigating through the menu to a category. Introducing a stable PLP entry (men/women ready-to-wear view-all) plus cookie dismissal and robust product tile selectors should consistently materialize the PLP. URL normalization avoids homepage traps and prevents accidental jumps to the corporate monclergroup.com domain.
code_hints: After goto, if no PLP tiles within 3-5s, click #onetrust-accept-btn-handler if present, then re-check.
If still no tiles and current path is '/' or '/en-jp/', navigate directly to /en-jp/men/ready-to-wear/view-all (then fallback to women view-all if needed).
Before concluding PLP empty, scroll incrementally (viewport height) up to max_rounds while re-querying product_link selectors.
Treat anchors leaving moncler.com or going to monclergroup.com as invalid; ignore such clicks.
If a nav link containing 'view-all' exists in header nav, prefer clicking it: header nav a[href*='view-all'].
